title: Motion tokens defined once with expected values
preconditions: App running (local production build or dev server); any page open in a desktop browser
steps: Open DevTools and read getComputedStyle(document.documentElement) for the motion custom properties (or inspect the Tailwind theme tokens) for fast, base, slow durations, ease-out curve and spring curve
Search the shipped CSS for where these tokens are declared
expected: Tokens declared in one place: fast ≈140 ms, base ≈220 ms, slow ≈360 ms (±20 ms), an ease-out cubic-bezier, and a spring easing whose overshoot is ≤ ~5% (e.g. cubic-bezier y-values ≤ 1.05 or linear() peak ≤ 1.05). Screenshot of computed values

title: Animated components use the shared tokens
preconditions: Signed in as a test user with at least one class
steps: Trigger a toast, a dialog open, a tab switch and the search result stagger
For each animating element, read getComputedStyle(el).animationDuration / transitionDuration and animationTimingFunction, or document.getAnimations() timing
expected: Each animation's duration matches one of the token values (≈140/220/360 ms) and its easing matches the token ease-out or spring curve; no ad-hoc durations outside the token set for these areas

title: Subject search results rise in with a stagger
preconditions: Signed in as test user; subjects dialog open; course catalogue (test data or mocked) returns ≥ 8 results for a query
steps: Type a query that returns ≥ 8 results
Record document.getAnimations() for each result row with startTime/delay, or read animation-delay per row
Take a screenshot ~100 ms after results appear (mid-animation)
expected: Each row has a translate-Y + opacity entrance; per-row delay increases by 30–60 ms; the last row's animation finishes within ~600 ms of the first starting; mid-animation screenshot shows rows at different opacity/offset

title: Add button rolls to 'Added ✓' and course pops into 'To add'
preconditions: Subjects dialog open with search results shown
steps: Click 'Add' on one result
Capture animations on the button and on the new 'To add' item; screenshot mid-animation
Wait 500 ms and screenshot the end state
expected: Button animates (text/label transition) to 'Added ✓'; the course appears in the 'To add' list with a scale/pop entrance (scale from <1 to 1, spring easing); end state shows 'Added ✓' and the item in 'To add'

title: Removing a course from 'To add' shrinks it out faster than it entered
preconditions: At least one course in the 'To add' list
steps: Click the remove control on the course in 'To add'
Record the exit animation duration and compare with the pop-in duration from TC-04
expected: Item scales down/fades out and is then removed from the DOM; exit duration is shorter than the entrance duration; the matching result's button returns to 'Add'

title: Toast enters with an upward spring and exits sideways
preconditions: Signed in; an action that shows a toast (e.g. save notes, add subject)
steps: Trigger a success toast; record its entrance animation (transform keyframes, easing) and screenshot mid-entrance
Dismiss it (close or wait for auto-dismiss); record exit keyframes and screenshot mid-exit
expected: Entrance translates from below (positive Y) to 0 with spring easing, finishes ≤ ~400 ms; exit translates on X and fades opacity to 0, and is shorter than the entrance

title: Several toasts stack without overlapping text
preconditions: Signed in; ability to fire 3 toasts quickly (repeat an action or via test hook)
steps: Trigger 3 toasts within 1 second
After animations settle, read getBoundingClientRect() of each toast's text
Screenshot at desktop width and at 390 px
expected: Toast text rectangles do not intersect; all toasts readable; close buttons work; behaviour matches the existing toast stacking

title: Active-tab highlight slides between Type / Handwrite / Transcribe
preconditions: Signed in; a test class with the class workspace open
steps: Note the highlight element's bounding rect on 'Type'
Click 'Transcribe'; sample the highlight rect every ~30 ms for 400 ms (or read its transform/left transition); screenshot mid-slide
Repeat on another tab bar in the class workspace
expected: The highlight moves continuously from the old tab position to the new one (intermediate positions observed) using a transform/position transition, ends exactly under the selected tab; the same on other workspace tab bars

title: Tab panel content fades/rises in on switch
preconditions: Class workspace open
steps: Switch tabs and inspect document.getAnimations() on the newly shown panel
Screenshot ~80 ms after switching
expected: New panel has an opacity (and optional small translate-Y) entrance ≤ ~400 ms; old panel content is not left visible on top; mid-animation screenshot shows partial opacity

title: Keyboard tab switching still works
preconditions: Class workspace open
steps: Tab focus to the tab list
Press ArrowRight / ArrowLeft / Home / End and Enter/Space as applicable
expected: Focus and selection move between tabs as before; aria-selected updates; highlight slides to the keyboard-selected tab; the correct panel is shown

title: Slide upload shows a filling progress indicator then a ✓ pop
preconditions: Signed in; test class open; storage upload mocked or throttled (DevTools network 'Slow 3G') so upload takes several seconds; test PDF deck
steps: Add slides → choose the test PDF
Screenshot at ~25% and ~75% of the upload; read the indicator's width/value/aria-valuenow
Screenshot on completion
expected: A visible progress indicator is shown and its fill increases over time; on success it turns into a ✓ with a scale pop animation; the existing success toast/state still appears

title: Slide thumbnails/pages enter one after another
preconditions: Upload of a multi-page test deck (≥ 4 pages) just completed, or a class with a deck opened where thumbnails are shown
steps: Record animations on thumbnail/page elements as they appear
Screenshot mid-sequence
expected: Thumbnails have entrance animations with increasing delays (staggered); mid-sequence screenshot shows some thumbnails visible and later ones still entering

title: Slide upload error still shows as before
preconditions: Storage upload mocked to fail (e.g. 500), or an unsupported/oversized test file
steps: Add slides → choose the file
Observe the indicator and messages
expected: No ✓ is shown; the existing error message/toast appears as today; the progress indicator is removed or reset; the user can retry

title: Recording ring pulses and level bars follow microphone
preconditions: Chromium launched with --use-fake-ui-for-media-stream --use-fake-device-for-media-stream (fake tone/audio file); class workspace Transcribe tab open
steps: Start recording
Confirm an infinite pulse animation on the ring around the record control (getAnimations, iterations = Infinity)
Sample level bar heights/transforms every 100 ms for 2 s; screenshot twice
Switch fake input to silence if possible and sample again
expected: Ring pulse animation running; level bar values change over time with input (not identical every sample) and drop to minimal with silence; update rate roughly 10–20 fps

title: Pulse and level bars stop when recording stops
preconditions: Recording in progress (as TC-14)
steps: Stop recording
Wait 500 ms; inspect getAnimations() on the ring and level bar values; check that the mic track is stopped
expected: No running pulse animation; level bars static/hidden; no ongoing requestAnimationFrame-driven level updates; the recording is processed as before

title: Record button morphs into 'Recording · m:ss' pill and back
preconditions: Fake media stream as in TC-14; Transcribe tab open
steps: Read the record button's width and border-radius; note the dot shape
Click start; screenshot mid-morph (~100 ms) and after settle
Read text at t≈1 s, 2 s, 3 s, and at 65 s
Click stop; screenshot mid-reverse and after settle
expected: Button widens from round to a pill (width transition observed), shows 'Recording · 0:01', '0:02', '0:03' … '1:05' updating once per second, includes level bars; dot morphs into a square (border-radius change); on stop it returns to the original round button with the dot

title: Record button accessible name says Start/Stop recording
preconditions: Transcribe tab open
steps: Read the accessible name (Playwright getByRole('button', {name}) or DevTools accessibility pane) before recording
Start recording and read it again; stop and read again
Operate the button with keyboard (Space/Enter)
expected: Name contains 'Start recording' when idle and 'Stop recording' while recording (the timer text does not replace it); keyboard activation works

title: Empty states show a gently floating illustration
preconditions: Fresh test user with no classes; a class with no notes
steps: Open the home/dashboard with no classes; inspect the empty-state illustration/icon animations
Open the class with no notes; inspect its empty state
Take two screenshots ~1 s apart
expected: Illustration has an infinite, slow translate-Y float animation (small amplitude, a few px); screenshots show slight vertical offset difference; empty-state text and actions unchanged

title: Invalid sign-in shakes the field once and error slides open
preconditions: Signed out; /auth page open; auth requests to Supabase mocked or using a non-existent test email
steps: Enter an invalid email (e.g. 'abc') or wrong password and submit
Record animations on the field (keyframes on translate-X, iteration count) and on the error message (height/opacity/translate)
Submit again with the same invalid value
expected: Field shakes horizontally exactly once (iterationCount 1) per invalid submission; error message animates open (slide/expand) and its text is the existing error copy; second submit shakes again once; valid sign-in still works

title: Primary buttons show cursor-following light on fine pointer
preconditions: Desktop browser with mouse (matchMedia('(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)') true)
steps: Move the mouse to the left side of a primary button, read the light's position (CSS vars / background-position / pseudo-element); screenshot
Move to the right side and read again; screenshot
expected: A soft radial highlight is visible on the button and its position follows the cursor (values differ between left and right positions); it disappears on mouse leave

title: Class cards tilt at most 4° on hover
preconditions: Fine-pointer desktop browser; home/dashboard with ≥ 1 test class card
steps: Hover each corner of a class card; read computed transform and decompose rotateX/rotateY
Move mouse out
expected: Card tilts toward the pointer; absolute rotateX and rotateY each ≤ 4°; card returns to flat on mouse leave; card remains clickable

title: No hover light or tilt on touch devices
preconditions: Playwright device emulation iPhone 13/14 (390 px, hasTouch, pointer: coarse, hover: none)
steps: Tap and long-press a primary button and a class card
Inspect computed transform and light-layer state during/after touch
expected: No cursor-light effect and no tilt transform (transform none / identity); taps navigate/act normally

title: Class card morphs into class header and back (View Transitions)
preconditions: Chromium with View Transitions API; signed in; ≥ 2 test classes on home and dashboard
steps: On home, read view-transition-name of each class card (must be unique per class)
Click a class card; during navigation check document.getAnimations() for ::view-transition-group(<name>) or that a transition is active; screenshot mid-morph
On the class page confirm the header has the same view-transition-name
Press browser Back and screenshot mid-morph
Repeat from the dashboard
expected: Card and class header share a unique name; a view-transition group animation runs between the card's and header's geometry on open and again on back; the class page loads correctly afterwards

title: Browsers without View Transitions navigate normally
preconditions: Firefox (or Chromium with document.startViewTransition deleted via addInitScript)
steps: Open home and click a class card
Press Back
expected: Navigation to the class page and back works instantly with no console errors; class content correct

title: Transcript highlight follows playback, scrolls, survives pause, moves on seek
preconditions: Test class with a saved lecture recording (test audio ≥ 60 s) and a long transcript without timestamps
steps: Play the recording; at ~5 s note which transcript part is highlighted and whether it is in the scroll viewport
Let it play to ~30 s; check the highlight moved later in the text and is still in view
Pause; wait 3 s; confirm highlight unchanged
Seek to ~90% of the duration; check the highlight jumps near the end of the transcript and scrolls into view
expected: Exactly one highlighted part, its position in the text roughly proportional to currentTime/duration; it stays visible in the scroll container; pause keeps it; seek moves it

title: 'Improve with audio' result fades in with 'Improved' badge pop
preconditions: Test lecture with recording; AI/transcription endpoint mocked to return an improved transcript
steps: Click 'Improve with audio'
When it completes, record animations on the transcript container and on the badge; screenshot mid-animation
expected: Improved transcript text replaces the old one with an opacity fade-in; an 'Improved' badge appears with a scale pop; on error the existing error handling is shown

title: Reduced motion removes movement across all animated areas
preconditions: Browser emulating prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (Playwright reducedMotion: 'reduce'); fake media stream; test data as for other cases
steps: For each area, trigger it and inspect animation keyframes / computed transform: search stagger + Add/To-add pop (2), toast in/out (3), tab highlight + panel (4), upload ✓ pop + thumbnails (8), recording pulse + level bars (9), record button morph (20), empty-state float + sign-in shake + error open (12), hover light + card tilt (14), card→header view transition (18), transcript highlight scroll + improved fade (19)
Screenshot each final state
expected: No keyframes or transitions on transform/translate/scale/rotate in any area (no slide, spring, scale, tilt, shake, pulse, float, morph; view transition not run or crossfade only); opacity/colour fades may remain; transcript scrolling is non-smooth; every element still appears in its correct final state and all functions work (Add, toasts, tabs, upload ✓, recording with timer and Stop name, error message, navigation)

title: Entrance animations ≤ ~400 ms and exits faster than entrances
preconditions: Desktop browser, default motion
steps: For dialog open, toast, tab panel, To-add pop, ✓ pop, error slide-open, badge pop: read effect.getComputedTiming().endTime (duration + delay, excluding stagger offsets)
For dialog close, toast exit, To-add removal: read exit durations
expected: Every entrance ≤ ~400 ms (stagger delays excepted); every exit duration < its matching entrance duration

title: Animations never block clicks or typing
preconditions: Subjects dialog and sign-in page available
steps: Open the subjects dialog and immediately (within 50 ms) type into the search field
While results are still staggering in, click 'Add' on the first row
While a toast is entering, click a button under/near it; switch tabs twice rapidly
On sign-in, type into the field during the shake
expected: All keystrokes register, clicks act on first try, rapid tab switches end on the last chosen tab; no pointer-events: none overlay blocks interaction during animations

title: No animation on the notes editor typing area or pen canvas
preconditions: Class workspace open
steps: In the Type tab, type 20 characters; inspect document.getAnimations() filtered to the editor and descendants
In the Handwrite tab, draw strokes; inspect getAnimations() and computed transition on the canvas and its container
Check computed transform on the canvas
expected: Zero animations/transitions on the editor typing area and pen canvas; canvas transform none (strokes align with the pointer exactly); typing latency unchanged

title: Regression: dialogs, uploads, recording, transcript and navigation behave as before
preconditions: Test user; mocked AI/transcription; fake media stream
steps: Open and close the subjects dialog with Esc, overlay click and close button; add a subject end to end
Upload slides and view them
Record 10 s, stop, confirm the recording is saved and transcribed
Play the saved recording; open/close notes; navigate home ↔ class ↔ dashboard with links and Back/Forward
expected: Every flow completes as before; focus is trapped/restored in dialogs; data saved; no console errors

title: 390 px phone width: no horizontal scroll with animations
preconditions: Viewport 390×844, touch emulation
steps: Visit sign-in, home, dashboard, class workspace, subjects dialog
Trigger toasts, tab switches, recording pill, slide upload; during and after each, check document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= 390
Screenshot each page
expected: scrollWidth never exceeds clientWidth (including mid-animation for sideways toast exit and recording pill); recording pill fits; content readable

title: Typecheck, unit tests and build pass
preconditions: Branch claude/motion-polish checked out, dependencies installed
steps: Run bun run typecheck
Run the unit test suite
Run bun run build
Check package.json diff for new animation dependencies
expected: All three commands exit 0; no new animation library added (only CSS / Web Animations / tw-animate-css)
